nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances in ERC20
Private nested mapping of owner->spender->allowance in ERC20
Private uint256 total token supply, minted and burned
Private string token name set in constructor
Private string token symbol set in constructor
Private uint8 decimals value defaulted to 18
Public constant DECIMALS = 18 in BabyDoge
Public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 100000000000000 * 10**18 in BabyDoge
msg.sender used as caller identity throughout the token contract
Context._msgSender() returns msg.sender as address payable
ERC20.transfer sends tokens from _msgSender() to recipient
ERC20.approve sets allowance from _msgSender() to spender
ERC20.transferFrom moves tokens and decrements allowance
ERC20.increaseAllowance adds to the caller's allowance for spender
ERC20.decreaseAllowance subtracts from the caller's allowance for spender
Internal ERC20._mint increasing _totalSupply and a recipient balance
Internal ERC20._burn decreasing a balance and _totalSupply
Virtual hook ERC20._beforeTokenTransfer invoked before any balance change
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom decrements allowance then burns from another account
BabyDoge constructor naming the token and minting INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender
State-changing mint of the entire INITIAL_SUPPLY to the deploying address
State-changing burn that destroys balances and reduces total supply
Subtraction and addition writes to the _balances mapping inside _transfer
Direct write to the _allowances mapping inside _approve
transfer(address recipient) destination address supplied by the caller
transfer(uint256 amount) token quantity supplied by the caller
transferFrom(address sender) source account supplied by the caller
transferFrom(address recipient) destination address supplied by the caller
transferFrom(uint256 amount) token quantity supplied by the caller
_transfer(address sender) source address
_transfer(address recipient) destination address
_transfer(uint256 amount) token quantity
_mint(address account) beneficiary of newly created tokens
_mint(uint256 amount) quantity of tokens created
_burn(address account) account whose tokens are destroyed
_burn(uint256 amount) quantity of tokens destroyed
_approve(address owner) allowance owner
_approve(address spender) allowance spender
_approve(uint256 amount) allowance value
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom(address account) account burned from
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom(uint256 amount) quantity burned via allowance

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender()
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the token movement
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender of the allowance
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
burn destroys tokens of _msgSender()
burnFrom uses _msgSender() to debit the caller allowance
BabyDoge constructor mints the initial supply to msg.sender
constructor reads INITIAL_SUPPLY as the mint amount
INITIAL_SUPPLY is computed with an unchecked multiplication of 100000000000000 by 10**18 under pragma 0.7
constructor triggers the initial mint operation via _mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY)
constructor calls the internal _mint function
the mint increases _totalSupply
the mint increases the recipient entry of _balances
transfer delegates the token movement to _transfer
transferFrom delegates the token movement to _transfer
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve
transferFrom reads _allowances to subtract the spent amount
approve updates the allowance through _approve
increaseAllowance updates the allowance through _approve
decreaseAllowance updates the allowance through _approve
_transfer invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before any write
_transfer performs the subtraction and addition balance writes
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping
the balance update operation mutates _balances for sender and recipient
_mint increases _totalSupply using SafeMath.add
_mint increases the account balance in _balances
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances
_burn decreases _totalSupply using SafeMath.sub
_approve performs the allowance mapping write
the allowance update operation writes _allowances[owner][spender]
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
ERC20Burnable.burn calls the internal _burn
burn triggers the token destruction operation
burnFrom approves the reduced allowance through _approve
burnFrom calls the internal _burn on the target account
burnFrom triggers the token destruction operation
the burn operation reduces the burned account balance in _balances
the burn operation reduces _totalSupply
transfer.recipient parameter is consumed by transfer()
transfer.amount parameter is consumed by transfer()
transferFrom.sender parameter is consumed by transferFrom()
transferFrom.recipient parameter is consumed by transferFrom()
transferFrom.amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom()
_transfer.sender parameter is consumed by _transfer()
_transfer.recipient parameter is consumed by _transfer()
_transfer.amount parameter is consumed by _transfer()
_mint.account parameter is consumed by _mint()
_mint.amount parameter is consumed by _mint()
_burn.account parameter is consumed by _burn()
_burn.amount parameter is consumed by _burn()
_approve.owner parameter is consumed by _approve()
_approve.spender parameter is consumed by _approve()
_approve.amount parameter is consumed by _approve()
burnFrom.account parameter is consumed by burnFrom()
burnFrom.amount parameter is consumed by burnFrom()
